name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend
description: Web application entry: vite build over the @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web shell library; dist/ served by apps/cli's dsh web

scripts.build:runtime-plugins: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import crypto from 'node:crypto';const root='src/runtime-plugins',out='dist/plugins';for(const name of fs.readdirSync(root).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.js')))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,name),path.join(out,name));const file=path.join(out,'manifest.json'),manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));for(const entry of manifest.entries)entry.rev=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(path.join('dist',entry.url.startsWith('/')?entry.url.slice(1):entry.url))).digest('hex').slice(0,16);fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+String.fromCharCode(10));"
